This is the code base for the project. The input and intermediate files were queried
from databases or were outputs of analyses have been directly read into the code, however
steps to retrieve input data and reproduce results have been commented.

\

### 1. Loading Libraries
```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## 
library(here)

## Quering and reading TCGA data
# library("TCGAbiolinks")
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(MatrixGenerics)
library(matrixStats)

## Data wrangling
library(tidyverse)
# library("stringr")

## Stats
library(Hmisc) # for rcorr
library(clusterProfiler) # For over-representation analysis
library(multiMiR) # For miRNA targets


## Data visualisation
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
# library("cowplot")
library("RColorBrewer")
# library("colormap")

# library("ggnewscale")
```


### 2. Setting Variables
```{r}
study <- "TCGA-BRCA"
# study <- "TCGA-SKCM"

# File paths
input_data_common_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files")
input_data_study_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study)
results_save_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study)
plots_save_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study, "plots")
plot_title_prefix <- "BRCA"
# plot_title_prefix <- "SKCM"

rna_data_rds <- "BRCA-rna_data.RDS"
mirna_data_rds <- "BRCA-mirna_data.RDS"
# 
# rna_data_rds <- "SKCM_rna_data.RDS"
# mirna_data_rds <- "SKCM_mirna_data.RDS"

# Data filters
expression_threshold <- 60

# Target genes
genome <- "hg38"
peak.distance.from.TSS <- 5
TF_targets_path <- file.path(input_data_common_dir, "TF_targets")
cell_lines_threshold <- NULL
gene_peaks_in_cell_lines_threshold <- 0.5


# Plots
scatter_point_size = 3
opacity_alpha = 0.7
annot_text_size = 4
```






### 2. Data Collection 

Data source - https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/TCGA-SKCM 
\
\
Here, we are downloading miRNA and mRNA sequencing data from the
SKCM (Skin Cutaneous Melanoma) cohort of
The Cancer Genome Atlas (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/TCGA- SKCM). 
\
\
Uncomment the following code to query the data files for the required criteria.

\
```{r, echo=FALSE}
rna_data <- readRDS(file.path(input_data_study_dir, rna_data_rds))
mirna_data <- readRDS(file.path(input_data_study_dir, mirna_data_rds))
```


### 3. Data Preparation

\
We will only consider protein-coding transcripts from the `RNA` expression data.
\
```{r, warning=FALSE}
rna_data_protein_coding <- rna_data[which(rowData(rna_data)$gene_type == "protein_coding"),]

rna_analysis <- as.data.frame(rna_data_protein_coding@assays@data@listData$tpm_unstrand)
names(rna_analysis) <- rna_data_protein_coding$sample

row.names(rna_analysis) <-rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)@rownames

# Storing gene names from TCGA data here - because some gene IDs have the same gene symbol,
# duplicate row names cannot be assigned in the previous step
gene_mapping <- data.frame(gene_id = rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)@rownames,
                           gene_symbol = rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)$gene_name)
```

\
Cleaning miR data for further analysis - making the column name of `miRNA` 
expression the same as `RNA` expression.
\
```{r}
# select RPM of miRNA for correlation analysis
miRNA_analysis <-  mirna_data %>%
              dplyr::select(miRNA_ID, contains("reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped"))

# rename rows (miRNA ID) and columns (patient ID)
rownames(miRNA_analysis) <- miRNA_analysis$miRNA_ID
colnames(miRNA_analysis) <- gsub("reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_", "", colnames(miRNA_analysis))

# drop column miRNA_ID (this information is stored in row names)
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>% dplyr::select(-miRNA_ID)

# To make the miRNA column name match the sample ID
names(miRNA_analysis) <- gsub("-[^-]*$","",
                              # "-": match string with "-"
                              # "-[^-]*": match all non "-" strings followed by the "-"
                              # "$": match only at the last occurrence of the pattern
                              gsub("-[^-]*$","",
                                   # repeat three times to remove the strings after the 3rd last ""
                                   gsub("-[^-]*$","",names(miRNA_analysis))))
```


\
Right now, the data size is as follows:
\
```{r}
dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```

\
```{r}
common_cols <- intersect(names(rna_analysis), names(miRNA_analysis))

# Keep RNA samples with miRNA data
# rna_analysis <- rna_analysis[, names(miRNA_analysis)[which(names(miRNA_analysis) %in% names(rna_analysis))]]
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Match the samples of miRNA data with RNA data
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat(length(names(miRNA_analysis)), "samples have matched mRNA & miRNA data\n")

dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```
\


#### 3.1 Removing genes with no expression
\
We first filter out `rNA` and `miRNA` with no expression, i.e., rows which have only 0's:
\

```{r}
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(.) > 0)

rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(.) > 0)
```
\
New data dimensions:
\
```{r}
dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```
\

#### 3.3 Removing low-expressed transcripts

```{r}
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>%
  mutate(ZeroPercentage = rowMeans(. == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ZeroPercentage <= expression_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ZeroPercentage)

miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  mutate(ZeroPercentage = rowMeans(. == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ZeroPercentage <= expression_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ZeroPercentage)


dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```


#### 3.4 Log transforming data 
\
Add 1 and take log2 of each value in both datasets:
\
```{r}
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>% mutate_all(~ log2(. + 1))
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>% mutate_all(~ log2(. + 1))
```


```{r}
# write.csv(rna_analysis, file.path(results_save_dir, "rNA_filtered_data.csv"), row.names = T)
# write.csv(miRNA_analysis, file.path(results_save_dir, "miRNA_filtered_data.csv"), row.names = T)
```


When reading data again:

```{r}
rna_analysis <- read_csv(file.path(input_data_study_dir, "rNA_filtered_data.csv")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = colnames(.)[1])

miRNA_analysis <- read_csv(file.path(input_data_study_dir, "miRNA_filtered_data.csv")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = colnames(.)[1])
```

```{r}
dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```

```{r}
rna_exp <- rna_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_exp = rowMeans(across(everything())),
                 RNA = row.names(.)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(z_transform_exp = scale(mean_exp)[,1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(RNA, z_transform_exp) %>%
  left_join(cor_result_sig %>% dplyr::select(RNA, RNA_symbol), by = "RNA") %>%
  distinct(RNA, .keep_all = TRUE)

miRNA_exp <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_exp = rowMeans(across(everything())),
                 miRNA = row.names(.)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(z_transform_exp = scale(mean_exp)[,1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA, z_transform_exp)

cor_exp <- cor_result_sig %>%
  left_join(miRNA_exp, by = "miRNA") %>%
  dplyr::rename(miRNA_exp = z_transform_exp) %>%
  left_join(rna_exp %>% dplyr::select(RNA_symbol, z_transform_exp), by = "RNA_symbol") %>%
  dplyr::rename(rna_exp = z_transform_exp)

```

#### 4.4 Which miRNAs have correlated genes and intercations with known TFs?

```{r}
# Number of TFs ineracting with each miRNA

miRNA_TF_num <- interactions_TFs %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>% 
  summarise(num_TFs = n())
```


```{r}
miR_TF <- interactions_TFs %>% 
  dplyr::select(miRNA, target_symbol) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(target_symbol %in% TF_available) %>%
  distinct()

overlap_analysis_data <- cor_result_sig %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    positively_cor_genes = sum(coef > 0),
    negatively_cor_genes = sum(coef < 0),
    count = n()
  )

overlap_analysis_data <- inner_join(overlap_analysis_data, miR_TF, by = "miRNA") %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  mutate(count = n()) %>%
  dplyr::rename(TF = target_symbol, num_TF_interactions = count)
```

```{r}
dim(overlap_analysis_data)
```

### 6. Visualisations



```{r}
get_top_cor_stats <- function(overlap_df, cor_result, prefix) {
  top_cor_gene <- list()
  top_cor_coef <- list()
  avg_cor_coef <- list()

  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(overlap_df), style = 3)

  for (i in 1:nrow(overlap_df)) {
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)

    gene_list <- unlist(strsplit(overlap_df[[paste0(prefix, "_overlap_geneID")]][i], "/"))

    cor_pairs <- cor_result %>%
      filter(miRNA == overlap_df$miRNA[i], RNA_symbol %in% gene_list)

    if (prefix == "poscor"){
     top_val <- max(cor_pairs$coef) 
    } else {
      top_val <- min(cor_pairs$coef) 
    }

    top_cor_gene[[i]] <- cor_pairs %>% filter(coef == top_val) %>% pull(RNA_symbol)
    top_cor_coef[[i]] <- top_val
    avg_cor_coef[[i]] <- mean(cor_pairs$coef)
  }

  close(pb)

  overlap_df <- overlap_df %>%
     ungroup() %>%  
    mutate(
      top_cor_gene = unlist(top_cor_gene),
      top_cor_coef = unlist(top_cor_coef),
      avg_cor_coef = unlist(avg_cor_coef)
    )
  
  epsilon <- 1e-10  # small value to avoid log(0)
  
  # Filter and mutate input df
  overlap_df <- overlap_df %>%
    filter(.data[[paste0(prefix, "_ora_pval.adj")]] < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      qval_plot = -log10(.data[[paste0(prefix, "_ora_pval.adj")]] + epsilon),
      miR_TF = paste(gsub("^hsa-", "", miRNA), " - ", TF)
    )
  
  return(overlap_df)
}
```

#### 6.1 miRNA - TF top pairs

```{r}
plot_top_mir_tf_pairs <- function(df, title, y_limit = 10.5, top_n = 5, type = "pos") {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  
  if (type == "neg") {
    df <- df %>% mutate(top_cor_coef = abs(top_cor_coef))
    point_color <- "#9C354B"
    y_label <- expression(-log[10](qvalue))
    x_label <- "Absolute Correlation Coefficient of \nTop Correlated Gene"
  } else {
    point_color <- "#0D84CD"
    y_label <- expression(-log[10](qvalue))
    x_label <- "Correlation Coefficient of \nTop Correlated Gene"
  }
  
  top_pairs <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(top_cor_coef), qval_plot) %>%
    head(top_n)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = top_cor_coef, y = qval_plot)) +
    geom_point(color = point_color, size = scatter_point_size, alpha = opacity_alpha) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_limit)) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_pairs,
                    aes(label = miR_TF),
                    force = 1,
                    direction = "both",
                    segment.size = 0.2,
                    color = "black",
                    nudge_x = 0.1, 
                    nudge_y = 0.1,
                    max.overlaps = 1000, 
                    size = annot_text_size) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      # title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(plot = p, filename = file.path(plots_save_dir, paste0(title, ".png")), width = 8, height =
           5)
  
  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
# Unified plotting function for interaction plot
plot_interactions <- function(interactions_plot, overlap_result, title, sig_color) {
  plot_data <- interactions_plot %>%
    dplyr::mutate(connection = if_else(miR_TF %in% unique(overlap_result$miR_TF),
                                       "Significant", "Not Significant"))

  interactions_long <- reshape2::melt(plot_data, na.rm = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = case_when(
      variable == "miRNA_exp" ~ "miRNA",
      variable == "TF_exp" ~ "TF",
      TRUE ~ variable
    ))

  top_miRs <- interactions_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(connection == "Significant") %>%
    group_by(miRNA) %>%
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(count)) 

  top_miRs_data <- interactions_long %>%
    filter(miRNA %in% top_miRs$miRNA, variable == "miRNA") %>%
    distinct(miRNA, .keep_all = TRUE)

  top_TFs <- interactions_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(connection == "Significant") %>%
    group_by(TF) %>%
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(count)) %>%
    head(5)

  top_TFs_data <- interactions_long %>%
    filter(TF %in% top_TFs$TF, variable == "TF") %>%
    distinct(TF, .keep_all = TRUE)

  pd <- position_dodge(0.2)

  p <- ggplot(interactions_long, aes(x = variable, y = value, group = miR_TF)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = variable), position = pd, show.legend = F, size = scatter_point_size, alpha = opacity_alpha) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("miRNA" = "#89b7d7",
                                "TF" = "#ffbb78"), name = "Gene Type") +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_miRs_data,
                  aes(label = miRNA),
                  # nudge_x = -0.2, nudge_y = 0.1,
                  position = pd,
                  force = 1.5,
                  direction = "both",
                  segment.size = 0.2,
                  color = "black",
                  max.overlaps = 1000, 
                  size = annot_text_size,
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_TFs_data,
                  aes(label = TF),
                  # nudge_x = 0.15, nudge_y = 0.1,
                  position = position_dodge(0.2),
                  force = 1.5,
                  direction = "both",
                  segment.size = 0.2,
                  color = "black",
                  max.overlaps = 1000, 
                  size = annot_text_size,
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_line(aes(color = connection, alpha = connection), position = pd) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = sig_color,
                                "Not Significant" = "gray"), 
                     name = "Over-representation \nAnalysis Significance") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Significant" = 0.35, "Not Significant" = 0.35)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression Level \n(z-transformed)",
       # title = title
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(alpha = "none")
  
  ggsave(plot = p, filename = file.path(plots_save_dir, paste0(title, ".png")), width = 8, height = 5)
  
  return(p)
}
```

#### 6.4 miR indirect target bar plots

This code is not needed anymore as we remove miR's direct targets in the overlapping gene set 
and then run over-representation analysis.


```{r}
get_miR_indirect_targets <- function(results_df, cor_result_sig, direction, prefix) {
   
  interaction_file <- file.path(results_save_dir, paste0("interactions_miR_gene_", direction, ".csv"))
  
  if (file.exists(interaction_file)) {
    cat("Reading existing file...", "\n")
    interactions_miR_gene_df <- read_csv(interaction_file)
  } else {
    interactions_miR_gene <- get_multimir(
      org = "hsa",
      mirna = results_df$miRNA,
      table = "validated",
      summary = TRUE,
      use.tibble = TRUE
    )
  
    interactions_miR_gene_df <- as.data.frame(interactions_miR_gene@data) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(miRNA = tolower(mature_mirna_id))
  
    write_csv(interactions_miR_gene_df, interaction_file)
  }
  

  results_final_path <- file.path(results_save_dir, paste0("results_", direction, 
                                                           "miR_indirect_targets.csv")
                                  )
  
  if (file.exists(results_final_path)) {
    cat("Results already exist, reading... ", "\n")
    
    results_df <- read_csv(results_final_path)
  } else {
    miR_direct_target_genes <- list()
    miR_direct_target_genes_prop <- list()
    
    miR_indirect_target_genes <- list()
    miR_indirect_target_genes_prop <- list()
    
    top_cor_indirect_gene <- list()
    top_cor_coef_indirect <- list()
    avg_cor_coef_indirect <- list()
    
    pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(results_df), style = 3)
  
    for (i in 1:nrow(results_df)) {
      
      setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    
      miR <- results_df$miRNA[i]
    
      gene_list <- unlist(strsplit(results_df[[paste0(prefix, "_overlap_geneID")]][i], "/"))
    
      interactions_miR <- interactions_miR_gene_df %>%
        filter(miRNA == miR) %>% pull(target_symbol)
    
      common_genes <- intersect(gene_list, interactions_miR)
    
      indirect_targets <- setdiff(gene_list, common_genes)
      # 
      # cor_pairs <- cor_result_sig %>%
      #   filter(miRNA == miR, RNA_symbol %in% indirect_targets)
      
      # if (direction == "pos"){
      #  top_val <- max(cor_pairs$coef) 
      # } else {
      #   top_val <- min(cor_pairs$coef) 
      # }
      # 
      # top_cor_indirect_gene[[i]] <- cor_pairs %>% filter(coef == top_val) %>% pull(RNA_symbol)
      # 
      # top_cor_coef_indirect[[i]] <- top_val
      # 
      # avg_cor_coef_indirect[[i]] <- mean(cor_pairs$coef)
    
      miR_direct_target_genes[[i]] <- paste(common_genes, collapse = "/")
      miR_direct_target_genes_prop[[i]] <- length(common_genes) / length(gene_list)
    
      miR_indirect_target_genes[[i]] <- paste(indirect_targets, collapse = "/")
      miR_indirect_target_genes_prop[[i]] <- length(indirect_targets) / length(gene_list)
      }
    
     close(pb)
      
      results_df <- results_df %>%
        mutate(
                # top_cor_indirect_gene = unlist(top_cor_indirect_gene),
                # top_cor_coef_indirect = unlist(top_cor_coef_indirect),
                # avg_cor_coef_indirect = unlist(avg_cor_coef_indirect),
               miR_direct_target_genes = unlist(miR_direct_target_genes),
               miR_direct_target_genes_prop = unlist(miR_direct_target_genes_prop),
               miR_indirect_target_genes = unlist(miR_indirect_target_genes),
               miR_indirect_target_genes_prop = unlist(miR_indirect_target_genes_prop))
      
      write.csv(results_df, file.path(results_save_dir, paste0("results_", direction, "miR_indirect_targets.csv")), 
                row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  return(results_df)
}

generate_mir_indirect_targets_bar_plot <- function(results_df){

    dplyr::mutate(miR_direct_target_genes_prop_perc = miR_direct_target_genes_prop*100) %>%
    mutate(interval = cut(miR_direct_target_genes_prop_perc,
                          breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5),
                          labels = paste(seq(0, 95, by = 5), "-", seq(5, 100, by = 5), "%",sep = ""),
                          include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE))
  
  # Count the number of occurrences in each interval
  interval_counts <- miR_indirect_prop_df %>%
    group_by(interval) %>%
    summarise(count = n())
  
  title <- "miRs direct targets prop count - bar plot (positive)"
  
  # Plot the counts using ggplot2
  p <- ggplot(interval_counts, aes(x = interval, y = count)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#0D84CD", width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), 
              color = "black", 
              # position = position_stack(vjust = 1.08), 
              vjust = 0, 
              # nudge_y = .01, 
              size = 3.25) +
    # scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
    labs(title = "",
         x = "\nPercentage of Genes in the Overlapping Gene Set \nthat miRs Directly Target",
         y = "Count of miR-TF Pairs") +
    theme_minimal() 
    # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # ggsave(plot = p, filename = paste0("data_files/publication/TCGA-BRCA/plots/", title, ".png"), width = 8, height = 5)
  
  p
}

```



```{r}
library(mediation)

# Extract and align expression vectors
miR <- "hsa-mir-934"
TF <- "FOXC1"
mRNA <- "VGLL1"

expr_df <- data.frame(
  miRNA = as.numeric(miRNA_analysis[miR, ]),
  TF = as.numeric(rna_analysis[gene_mapping$gene_id[gene_mapping$gene_symbol == TF], ]),
  mRNA = as.numeric(rna_analysis[gene_mapping$gene_id[gene_mapping$gene_symbol == mRNA], ])
)


# Run mediation analysis
model.M <- lm(TF ~ miRNA, data = expr_df)
model.Y <- lm(mRNA ~ miRNA + TF, data = expr_df)
med.out <- mediate(model.M, model.Y, treat = "miRNA", mediator = "TF", boot = TRUE, sims = 1000)

summary(med.out)

```
